After the [[Dubravan]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Nevana]] led a group of [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] to a [[Unidentified bar (Dubrava)|bar]] in the [[Canal District]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dubrava/Legends|Dubrava]], an '''altercation''' broke out. The stormtroopers first torched the [[Cantina/Legends|bar]] with [[Flamethrower/Legends|flamethrowers]] and then fired upon the patrons with [[Blaster rifle/Legends|blaster rifles]], [[Death/Legends|killing]] most of them, including Nevana. The stormtroopers were trying to capture the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] [[Jal Te Gniev]], who was recruiting for the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] at the bar. Gniev fled the scene, but a pair of stormtroopers found him. The Dubravan boy [[Bobek]] fired upon the stormtroopers, allowing Gniev to escape, but bringing about Bobek's death. The incident prompted Gniev to flee Dubrava to warn the Rebel hero [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] that the Empire was after him.
